events.title: FLING UP TOGETHER is part of Games Under 5 Hours
events.summary: We’re excited to share that FLING UP TOGETHER is part of the second edition of Games Under 5 Hours, running from October 10 to October 24, 2026. Games Under 5 Hours celebrates short games with lasting impact: complete experiences you can actually finish, whether that’s a quick session after work or a weekend adventure with a friend. FLING UP TOGETHER is a 2-player co-op physics platformer where you and a friend are tied together by one rope. Climb floating islands, fling each other across gaps,

events.title: 15,000+ Wishlists on Steam! 🎉
events.summary: Thank you to everyone who has followed the game, added it to their wishlist, shared it with friends, and supported us along the way. Your excitement means everything to the team.We can’t wait to show you more soon. 💙

events.title: 7,500 Wishlists on Steam, Thank You!
events.summary: We are excited to announce that FLING UP TOGETHER has officially reached 7,500 wishlists on Steam! This is an important milestone for our team, and we could not have reached it without your support. Every wishlist, playtest, message, video, and share has helped more players discover the game. We truly appreciate everyone who has supported us throughout development. We are continuing to improve the game, review player feedback, and prepare more updates to share with you.
